notes.title: Hotfix 7 - 16/05/25
notes.content:
It's been quite the week! Thanks so much for all your feedback <3

- Added functionality for dropping items directly from the inventory.
- Press Delete (rebindable) while hovering an item in the inventory to drop the stack.
- Dropped items go into a new type of crate that spawns by the player.
- If a crate exists nearby, items go into it instead of creating a new crate.

- Revamped the movement speed bonus for Platforms and Habitats.
- Platforms now provide a 50% movement speed bonus, up from 10%. This also applies to the Surface Climber.
- Habitats now provides a 20% movement speed bonus, up from 10%.
- Improved handling for these bonuses so they're now fully consistent when moving around the Outpost (no slowdowns).

- Added a new interior facility access container at the rear of Epsilon.
- Added rebindable keybinds for Rotate Camera Left + Rotate Camera Right.

- Increased interaction radius of deathbox by 2x.
- Moved Advanced Electronics to RAPP level 2.

- Fixed constructions sometimes not being included in habitat cutaways.
- Fixed and improved weird lighting issues with greatwood pools in Lost World.
- Fixed slowdown when adding items to crafting/cooking queue.
- Optimisations across the board in areas where item icons are involved.

- Fixed display of potentially incorrect quantity of items produced from current craft in building info widget.
- Fixed incorrect dialogue on return to Epsilon after AI containment.
- Added extra checks and handling to attempt to fix disabled recipes bug.

- Added collision to the grass in the Lost World so that the 3D Cursor is always visible.
